description:
## Goal

Register morning-vision-walk as the first concrete phone-agent routine. End-to-end working in both browser-voice and (when available) twilio-voice modes.

## Scope

### Routine registration
- Skill id: morning-vision-walk (existing skill at scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/morning-vision-walk/)
- Pre-turn context source: existing director-swarm vision-walk-prep agent last-handoff.md
- Agent-manager profile: read + write (the walk creates backlog items, knowledge entries, etc.)
- Schedule: configurable daily time

### Integration with existing prep agent
- The 5am vision-walk-prep agent continues to run and produce last-handoff.md
- The routine attaches last-handoff.md as pre-turn context on the first turn so the agent enters the call already briefed
- Decide during execution whether to consume it via routine pre-hook or pass it as initial run context

## Acceptance

- A scheduled trigger places an outbound call (or starts a browser-mode call when in browser-only mode) at the configured time
- The agent runs the 9-phase vision-walk conversation per the existing skill
- Decisions, action items, and knowledge entries land in their respective stores
- Transcript and outcomes are persisted to phone-agent call history
